name: s81ctrl_rg2_s3-s3-COMMIT
purpose: S81 CTRL rg2 SAFE: four wide-pitch (<=6 pins/um) dualclock 16x340 SRAM FIFOs, per-PC macro columns

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_ctrl_rg2 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DS81CTRL_SRAM_FIFO -DS81CTRL_SRAM_P192 --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_afifo.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ctrl/ot_s81ph_afifo_g.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ctrl/ot_s81ph_ctrl_pcr.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_glue/dsfd_rly_masters_dv276.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ctrl/dsfd_ctrl_rg2.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ctrl/ot_s81ph_afifo_g_sram.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w2c_16x340_p192/ot_sram_1r1w2c_16x340_p192_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81ctrl_rg2_s3/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81ctrl_rg2_s3/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81ctrl_rg2_s3 --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_ctrl_rg2 --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w2c_16x340_p192 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: LEAD2-S81/LINK-CTRL 10-19 SAFE successor of s81ctrl_rg2_np (route NEEDS_HUMAN on generated-clock export, fixed b91a2773d; its four stock 16x546 masters had 825 contacts per 81 um W/E face = 10.19/um > 6). Four wide-pitch dual-clock 16x340 masters (same compiler, pin pitch 0.192 um = 5.12/um, 114.48x100.71) replace them; one macro column per PC under that PC's W/E pin half (PC0 x86.4, PC1 x345.6; response FIFO bottom row, request FIFO top row), outline 531.25x324 (PHY PC pitch width). RTL/schedule identical (same Gray CDC FIFO, same read/write edges); inhold/outhold off as np.
